name: input-feedback
title: Input Feedback
description: Input field feedback for vertical reels: a labelled field shakes, a status chip pops and a hint appears. Valid is a neutral light chip, error turns border, chip and hint brand red. Brand palette tokens, Montserrat, sized for the 780 px graphics field. Mount it inside a clip with data-composition-id="input-feedback": its own timeline nests there.

variables.label: Status
variables.description: Whether the field reads as accepted or rejected, colouring the border, chip and hint.
